alerts.headline: Marine Weather Statement issued November 15 at 8:12PM PST by NWS Los Angeles/Oxnard CA
alerts.desc: A large west to northwesterly swell will produce a risk of breaking waves at the Morro Bay and Ventura Harbor entrances early Monday morning through late Monday night. These conditions have a history of capsizing vessels of various sizes resulting in serious injury or death, even to the most experienced mariners. Mariners are urged to stay clear of these harbor entrances. For more information, contact the local harbor patrol or coast guard station and continue to monitor NOAA Weather Radio for the latest weather information.
